statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
The diagnoses are R55 and G45.9.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197 for lack of required precertification or prior authorization.
